SELECT canonical_symbol AS canonicalSymbol, COUNT(1) AS rowCount, MIN(trade_date) AS firstDate, MAX(trade_date) AS lastDate FROM stock_daily_bar
GROUP BY canonical_symbol ORDER BY canonical_symbol

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stock_daily_bar
AND (high_price < low_price OR high_price < open_price OR high_price < close_price OR low_price > open_price OR low_price > close_price OR open_price <= 0 OR high_price <= 0 OR low_price <= 0 OR close_price <= 0)

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stock_daily_bar
AND (volume < 0 OR amount < 0 OR (volume > 0 AND (amount / volume < low_price OR amount / volume > high_price)))

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT canonical_symbol, trade_date FROM stock_daily_bar
GROUP BY canonical_symbol, trade_date HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) duplicated
